task.instruction: Tell me one bus stop that is nearest to the intersection of main street and Amherst street in Altavista.

final_answer:
The nearest bus stop to the intersection of Main Street and Amherst Street in Altavista, VA is **Amherst and 7th** — roughly 125 m (about a 2-minute walk) from the corner, at approximately 37.1145, -79.2839.

It edges out the next-closest option, **Main Street Middle** (about 128 m away), by only a couple of metres, so either is essentially at the corner. Other nearby stops in the results include 5th and Nelson (~305 m), 7th and Franklin (~355 m), and Franklin and 8th (~385 m).

judge.rationale: Google Maps showed nearby transit stops with coordinates; the agent computed distances from Amherst Ave & Main St and identified Amherst and 7th as slightly closest.
